title.narrative: DG ECHO PILOT PROGRAMMATIC PARTNERSHIP (PPP) - Netherlands Red Cross

description.narrative: The action will focus on 5 main pillars of intervention: 1) DRM 2) Epidemic, Pandemic Preparedness and Response 3) People on the move 4) Cash and Voucher Assistance (CVA); and 5) Community Engagement and Accountability (CEA)

The project has, since its inception, been implemented in Amolatar (Apac), Kaberamaido, Kayunga and Nakasongola districts i.e Lake Kyoga region, and Teso Region specifically Soroti, for the regional warehouse. In addition, the project expanded in Year 2 to include Bunyangabu, Kabarole, Kasese, Ntoroko, and Western Region/Rukungiri.

The project seeks to strengthen Uganda Red Cross Society's multi-hazard preparedness and response system from national, through district, down to community level, building linkages between EW/EA for a timely disaster preparedness, forecast-based action, and response.

This project focuses predominantly on the response capacity of OPM, DDMC, DTF, VHTs, partners and URCS at all levels. Based on the objectives of each activity the most relevant staff and volunteers will be selected based on their roles and responsibilities in the organisation while trying to strength the gender and other diversity balance. The selection criteria for multi-purpose cash and/or NFI distribution is informed by relevant assessments (needs assessments, RAM etc) based on the socio economic and vulnerability indicators of the community and will be validated by the DDMC, sub-county DMC, local leaders as well as the community members.

This project is important because it strengthens Uganda Red Cross Society's capacity to respond to the complex humanitarian challenges arising from hosting a large refugee population, managing internal displacement, and addressing the impacts of climate-related disasters and recurrent disease outbreaks.
